coffeeFarming.subtitle: Each bean is processed and roasted with precision to preserve its aroma and natural character. For us, coffee is not just a commodity, but a craft that connects nature, honest processes, and enjoyment in every sip.
coffeeFarming.harvestProcSubtitle: The coffee harvesting procedure is the process of picking ripe coffee cherries from the coffee tree. When coffee cherries reach optimal maturity, they typically display a red or reddish-brown color.
coffeeFarming.harvestProcStep1Desc: Coffee farmers will select the right time for harvesting. This may vary depending on the coffee variety, climate, and local practices. Harvesting is typically done when the coffee cherries have reached the desired level of ripeness.
coffeeFarming.harvestProcStep2Desc: Coffee harvesting is carried out by hand or using tools such as coffee pickers. Farmers carefully pick the ripe coffee cherries without damaging the tree or the unripe coffee beans.
coffeeFarming.harvestProcStep3Desc: After picking, the coffee cherries are sorted to separate the ripe ones from those that are unripe or damaged. This is important to ensure that only ripe, high-quality coffee cherries are processed further.
coffeeFarming.harvestProcStep4Desc: The sorted coffee cherries are then collected in special containers or baskets. The collected cherries are subsequently taken to the processing facility for further processing.
coffeeFarming.harvestProcOutro: Coffee harvesting requires precision and skill to choose the right timing and pick the cherries properly. The goal is to ensure that only ripe coffee cherries are harvested, producing high-quality coffee beans.
coffeeFarming.processSubtitle: The coffee processing in Humbang Hasundutan uses three main methods Wet, Semi-Wet, and Dry. Each produces a distinct flavor profile.
coffeeFarming.processWetDesc: The wet method (fermentation) produces coffee with bright flavors, high acidity, and distinct clarity.
coffeeFarming.processWetStep1Desc: Selecting ripe beans and discarding damaged ones.
coffeeFarming.processWetStep2Desc: Outer skin is removed mechanically, leaving mucilage.
coffeeFarming.processWetStep3Desc: Beans are soaked to remove mucilage and develop flavor profiles.
coffeeFarming.processWetStep4Desc: Intensive washing with water to remove remaining residue.
coffeeFarming.processWetStep5Desc: Beans are dried (sun/machine) and stirred until the target moisture is reached.
coffeeFarming.processWetStep6Desc: Parchment layer is removed to prepare beans for roasting.
coffeeFarming.processWetOutro: This method preserves quality with bright, acidic, and clear taste profiles.
coffeeFarming.processSemiDesc: A blend of wet and dry methods, creating unique flavors balancing acidity, richness, and smoothness.
coffeeFarming.processSemiStep2Desc: Outer skin removed, leaving mucilage layer.
coffeeFarming.processSemiStep3Desc: Short fermentation to remove mucilage and develop character.
coffeeFarming.processSemiStep4Desc: Deep cleaning to remove residual pulp.
coffeeFarming.processSemiStep5Desc: Sun or mechanical drying to ensure even results.
coffeeFarming.processSemiStep6Desc: Parchment separation to obtain green beans ready for roasting.
coffeeFarming.processSemiOutro: Semi-wet processing offers a unique profile combining acidity, richness, and smoothness.
coffeeFarming.processDryDesc: An all-natural method without fermentation, producing full-bodied, heavy, and meaty coffee.
coffeeFarming.processDryStep2Desc: Manual or mechanical removal of debris.
coffeeFarming.processDryStep3aDesc: Sun-dried and stirred regularly for 1–3 weeks for even drying.
coffeeFarming.processDryStep3bDesc: Accelerated drying using temperature-controlled machines and hot air.
coffeeFarming.processDryStep4Desc: Removing the husk/parchment to reveal green beans.
coffeeFarming.processDryOutro: Dry processing results in distinct, naturally sweet coffee with lower acidity.
coffeeFarming.roastingSubtitle: Each coffee bean is roasted with precise temperature and time control to produce the best flavor character, aroma, and body in every roasting profile.
coffeeFarming.roastingLevelLightDesc: Light character with bright acidity, floral aroma, and more pronounced fruity notes.
coffeeFarming.roastingLevelMediumDesc: The most balanced flavor with smooth body, warm sweetness, and rich aroma.
coffeeFarming.roastingLevelDarkDesc: Thick body with bold, smoky, dark chocolate character and more intense aftertaste.
coffeeFarming.roastingStdTempDesc: Roasting is performed using the High Temperature Short Time method to maintain consistent quality and coffee flavor.
coffeeFarming.roastingStdColorDesc: The color change of coffee beans serves as the primary indicator of roasting maturity level to produce an optimal flavor profile.
coffeeFarming.roastingStdCraftedDesc: Each roasting profile is designed to deliver a different coffee experience suited to modern coffee lovers' preferences.
coffeeFarming.roastingProfilesDark: High · Continental · European · Espresso · Viennese · Italian · French

company.subtitle: Every cup of coffee always begins with a story. For PT Siholta Toba Indonesia, that story is rooted in the rich natural heritage of the Indonesian archipelago and a commitment to delivering an authentic Indonesian coffee flavor.
company.storyBody1: In 2019, PT Siholta Toba Indonesia was founded with one mission: to bring Humbang Hasundutan specialty coffee known since the Dutch colonial era to the global stage. "Siholta" means "ancient tree" in Batak language, symbolizing deep roots and cherished heritage.
company.storyBody2: From dozens of partner farmers on the Sumatera slopes, we have grown into an integrated specialty coffee company operating three business sectors from agronomy to your cup.
company.visimisiHeadlineLeft: Bringing Lintong Nihuta to the World
company.visimisiVision: To become a nationally and internationally recognized coffee brand, bringing Lintong Nihuta, Humbang Hasundutan, as a producer of organic quality coffee without preservatives.
company.visimisiMission1: Serve quality coffee according to SNI and SCAA standards
company.visimisiMission2: Build mutually beneficial relationships with partners and coffee farmers
company.visimisiMission3: Present coffee flavors relevant to modern market needs
company.visimisiMission4: Improve farmer welfare through high-quality organic coffee
company.visimisiMission5: Make Lintong Nihuta coffee region a world-class coffee tourism destination
company.timelineSubtitle: Six years building Indonesia's specialty coffee ecosystem from farmer foundations to world standards.
company.sectorsSubtitle: PT Siholta Toba Indonesia runs its coffee business across three complementary sectors from upstream to downstream.
company.locationSub: PT Siholta Toba Indonesia operates from Jakarta as the center of business development and distribution, while the roots of our coffee originate from the highlands of Humbang Hasundutan, North Sumatra.
company.ctaSubtitle: Interested in Humbang Hasundutan specialty coffee? Contact our team for partnerships, farm visits, or business inquiries.
company.milestone2019Desc: PT Siholta Toba Indonesia officially established. The journey begins from the Humbang Hasundutan highlands, working directly with traditional coffee-farming families.
company.milestone2020Desc: Collaboration with over 200 farming families in Lintong and Dolok. Traditional Wet Hulling is preserved as the authentic specialty marker.
company.milestone2021Desc: Kopi Siholta products launch on Tokopedia and Shopee. Indonesian specialty coffee brand starts reaching across the archipelago.
company.milestone2022Desc: Kopi Siholta completed ready-to-serve food safety training as a commitment to quality, hygiene, and product serving standards.
company.milestone2023Desc: Kopi Siholta officially obtained halal certification to ensure every product is processed according to trusted Indonesian halal standards.
company.milestone2024Desc: Kopi Siholta is officially registered as a verified brand, strengthening local brand identity with a commitment to delivering quality Indonesian specialty coffee.
company.sector1Desc: 20+ partner farming families across Lintong & Dolok highlands. Traditional Wet Hulling produces the unique specialty character Humbang Hasundutan coffee is known for worldwide.
company.sector2Desc: From beverages to food centered on Indonesian specialty coffee. Every F&B item is made with premium specialty-grade beans processed to specialty standards.
company.sector3Desc: Coffee tourism experiences from farm to production. Farm and factory tours available for guests who want to discover the full story behind every cup.
company.certificationsSubtitle: Kopi Siholta is committed to delivering legal, trusted coffee products that meet quality standards for the national market.
company.certBrandDesc: Kopi Siholta is officially registered as a verified brand, strengthening local Indonesian brand identity with a commitment to quality and authentic taste.
company.certHalalDesc: Produced according to Indonesian halal standards to ensure every Kopi Siholta product is safe, trusted, and comfortable for all customers to enjoy.
company.certTrainingDesc: Our commitment to quality is realized through ready-to-serve food safety training to maintain hygiene, safety, and product quality standards in every serving process.
company.certPirtDesc: Official certification ensuring Kopi Siholta's food production process meets Indonesian industry food safety, quality, and legality standards.
